decision: NO dedicated Full inventory or Advanced browse scope.
rationale: Network, captured Map area, and intentional Search / Filter cover the primary tasks.
Empty Search / Filter stays empty instead of silently exposing the full dataset.
A supported technology filter is an explicit criterion and may intentionally return every matching loaded Cell.
secondaryDiscovery: Map inspection remains the spatial path to an exact Cell editor.
scaleLimit: Search scans the loaded array in memory. No backend pagination or external-operator scale claim is made.
revisitWhen: Real user evidence shows a task that the three scopes cannot perform, or measured loaded-inventory latency/memory becomes a blocker.
